## Purpose
A feature's renamable texts (Settings → Layout → Navigation menu): sidebar label, page title, page description and browser tab name.

## Responsibilities
- `useFeatureText(feature)` returns the saved overrides from `UI_NAV_LAYOUT`.
- `FeatureTitle` and `FeatureDescription` render children (the page's styled default) unless an override is saved. `BrandText` is an internal helper.

## Key elements
`useFeatureText`, `FeatureTitle`, `FeatureDescription`.

## Control flow
React rendering; data through React Query hooks where noted.

## Data, state and side effects
None beyond component state.

## Configuration
None.

## Interactions
- Uses `lib/uiConfig`. Used by most index pages for their header.

## Error handling and edge cases
None noted.

## Nuances and gotchas
- **An untouched page renders exactly as designed.**

## How to rebuild this file
Implement as described; copying the file is the reliable route for exact styling.
